blockers: The face is effectively a blank white mask with two tiny marks and an outline highlight; at 119px standing height it reads as unfinished and mildly uncanny rather than expressive.

Agnes does not yet communicate convincing heavy physical weight. The locomotion poses remain upright and mannequin-like, with insufficient torso counter-rotation, hip compression, or planted-foot authority.
Idle and gesture sheets show extremely low pose amplitude. The character appears to repeat near-identical frames rather than perform a readable anticipation, action, overshoot, and settle.
Torso, exposed arms, and thighs share nearly the same orange-peach value family, causing armor, flesh, and padded construction to merge. The intended heavy vambraces are not clearly readable.
The native render relies on soft gradients and blurred edge transitions rather than deliberate pixel clusters. At actual 1x scale, several contours and material boundaries lose graphic authority.

The silhouette is broad, but its major masses are arranged as a generic front-facing armored mannequin. The pauldron and buckler provide recognition, yet the body rhythm is not distinctive enough for a professional roster.
high_value_changes: Redesign the face as a compact, high-contrast pixel structure: establish a clear brow, nose or mask plane, mouth indication, and one controlled asymmetry. Avoid a featureless white circular head.

Separate materials with value and hue grouping: darken or desaturate the armor torso, give flesh a distinct midtone range, and make the vambraces visibly terminate at the wrists with hard silhouette breaks.
Rebuild the walk cycle around weight transfer: lower the pelvis on contact, compress the supporting knee, lean the torso into the step, and add a visible shoulder and buckler counter-swing.

Give the signature gesture a readable three-stage arc: preparation with backward load, forceful shield/arm action with clear silhouette expansion, then an overshoot and weighted settle. Do not use near-static interpolation.

Snap important contours and highlights into intentional pixel clusters at native resolution. Preserve selective shading, but remove low-contrast anti-aliased mush around the head, torso, legs, and weapon.
Push the silhouette beyond width alone: vary shoulder height, shield projection, hip angle, and leg spacing so Agnes reads as a grounded brawler rather than a symmetrical armored figure.
optional_notes: The 119px standing height and zero anchor drift satisfy the stated technical contract.
The asymmetric bronze pauldron, large buckler, and side weapon are useful recognition hooks, but they currently carry too much of the character identity by themselves.
The 4x nearest-neighbor sheet confirms scaling integrity, but nearest-neighbor enlargement does not compensate for weak native pixel grouping.

Compared with Celina, Agnes is correctly warmer and broader, but both share the same approximately 119px height, pale simplified head treatment, upright humanoid presentation, and diagonal side-weapon punctuation.
regressions_from_previous: No round-08 asset or prior Agnes sheet was provided, so direct temporal regression measurement is not possible.

Relative to the accepted Celina comparison, Agnes introduces stronger mass and asymmetry, but still converges on the roster's narrow vertical framing, simplified pale head, and front-facing armored mannequin construction.
The intended palette brief describes earthy ochre/rust, while the current result trends toward uniform peach-orange flesh and armor; this weakens the intended material and archetype distinction.
strongest_improvements: Technical placement is disciplined: the sprite is within the height contract and the ground anchor is stable.
The broad torso, thick legs, shield mass, and asymmetric shoulder element establish a more physically substantial silhouette than Celina.
The dark greaves and metallic accessory highlights remain legible against the warm body palette.
Eight-direction coverage is present and the side views preserve the shield and weapon identity.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Replace the blank face and redesign the full animation pass around visibly compressed, counter-rotating, planted weight; until Agnes has a readable face and a convincing heavy action rhythm, the strong accessories cannot rescue the mannequin-like presentation.
